bounds: The CI run itself is NOT verified here - the captain pushes; what is verified is that the gate now passes with the two gitignored files present AND with them moved aside, i.e. in both the developer-tree and clean-checkout conditions.

The self-test fixtures live in /tmp (no git work tree), so they exercise the WALK fallback; the git-index path is exercised by the real repository run and by the planted control's throwaway copy. No self-test creates a git repo (git init is outside this session's write scope).

A single-FILE asset (packages/mpd-bundle-plugin/client.js, packages/mpd-mcp-codegraph/dist/serve.js) is deliberately returned as its own list without an index lookup: the lock pins its raw sha256, so the asset IS the file. The tracked-file rule is a directory rule.
The walk fallback cannot detect a DELETED tracked file (it never knew the file existed); that check exists only on the index path. Stated as a bound, not a claim.
The git path enumerates the INDEX, so a file staged but not committed would be fingerprinted - in a clean checkout the index equals HEAD.

Not run here: verify:docs, verify-pack-closure, the Docker lanes, the live smoke cases (they are outside this scope and untouched by a scripts-only change); verify:gates covers docs-parity, dist-fresh, rows-parity and preset-conformance.
